decisions.reason: The award-winning high-pressure geothermal probe builds directly on the firm's tube and plastics expertise, so it can interpret results and keep improving the product.
The single-U geothermal probe extends the firm's established geothermal plastic piping line, where its related knowledge and R&D capability support continued refinement.
The surface technology for geothermal probes draws on the firm's materials and surface know-how and complements its geothermal portfolio, which favours retention.
The fire-protection steel profile system sits close to the firm's core building-systems competence, so the firm can readily assimilate market feedback.
The slim steel profile system builds on established steel profile technology, an area where the firm's deep related knowledge supports ongoing development.
The decorative surface system extends the existing steel profile offer and uses the firm's surface and materials expertise, though it is a more niche product.
